list.name: charizard
list.dex: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to cause forest fires unintentionally.

list.name: gengar
list.dex: Under a full moon, this Pokémon likes to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.

list.name: lucario
list.dex: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

list.name: snorlax
list.dex: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.

list.name: umbreon
list.dex: When agitated, this Pokémon pro tects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.

list.name: dragonite
list.dex: An extremely rarely seen marine Pokémon. Its intelligence is said to match that of humans.
